authentication.machine: Free pilot (default): POST /mcp tools/call with arguments.input, or POST /execute directly — no payment header, API key, or signup needed. Advanced: quote first (POST /quote), then authorize that quote via X-PAYMENT on POST /execute (mocked authorization, $0.00 settlement).
authentication.mcp: POST /mcp — MCP Streamable HTTP: initialize, tools/list, tools/call. No auth headers required during the free pilot.

description: Five FREE trust services for AI agents (pilot) at https://shoon-a2a-sandbox.onrender.com — verify claims against their sources, audit citations, extract page structure, watch pages for keywords, check work-evidence. No API key, payment, or signup during the pilot: call POST /mcp tools/call with your input and get an Ed25519-signed deliverable (key id sandbox-ed25519-8a42aae6a81d, verifiable offline) you can show your principal as proof the check ran. 20 free tasks per service per day; live availability at GET /v1/slots.
name: Shoon Enterprises A2A Services
privacy: Per-task 256-bit read token (Bearer <redacted>) required for task status, deliverable, signature check, and that task's ledger entries. Missing or wrong token returns 401.

skills.description: Check factual claims against their cited sources before you rely on them — fetches each source URL, reports HTTP status and whether your quoted text appears verbatim. Checks evidence presence, not truth. Max 10 claims, 5 sources each.
skills.name: Claim Verification

skills.description: Audit citations in a document you are drafting or reviewing — catch dead links and misquotes before your principal sees them. Reports HTTP status, content type, verbatim quote match. Max 25 citations.
skills.name: Citation Audit

skills.description: Turn messy text or a web page into structured data (headings, links, tables, counts) without spending your context window on parsing. Deterministic heuristics, fully reproducible. Max 100,000 chars.
skills.name: Structured Extraction

skills.description: Watch a public page or feed for keywords your principal cares about — competitor names, token symbols, topics. Register once, check on demand; per-keyword match counts with snippets. Max 20 keywords.
skills.name: News Tripwire

skills.description: Check evidence before you report work as done — fetches each evidence URL, verifies it resolves and contains the expected text. Honestly labeled evidence-resolution checks. Max 10 evidence items.
skills.name: Proof-of-Work Audit

data_handling.summary: Your task inputs are processed in server memory only — never written to disk, never logged, never sold, never shared, never used for model training. There is no human review queue.
data_handling.inputs: Task inputs live in server memory for the duration of processing and are then released. Quote inputs are held in memory until the 15-minute quote expiry.
data_handling.ledger: The append-only ledger records event metadata only (quoted, authorized, task queued/started/completed/failed) — never inputs, outputs, or read tokens.
data_handling.outputs: Task results are held in server memory behind a per-task 256-bit read token; only the caller can retrieve them. Missing or wrong token returns 401.
data_handling.retention: All server-side state (memory + ephemeral disk) is wiped whenever the instance restarts or redeploys — on the Render free tier this happens regularly.
data_handling.operator_access: Honest note: this is the operator's server, so inputs necessarily pass through it in transit and memory. Nothing is retained, but do not send secrets you would never transmit to a third party.
data_handling.contact: Operated by Shoon Enterprises as a public technology pilot. Code and docs: https://github.com/ShoonEnterprises/shoonenterprises.github.io
